svg.title: Nucleolus — Subcompartments
svg.desc: A nucleolar granular component containing multiple dense fibrillar components and fibrillar centers. Membraneless nucleolar organization is schematic and not to scale. Subcompartment number, shape and composition vary with species and state; no ribosome-production rate or molecular stoichiometry is encoded.
